notes: Releases are ordered by how well they will actually play. Swarm health now sets the band a release lands in, the 0.11 build's rule and the right one, and everything else decides the order within a band. Before, a trusted group at exactly the right resolution with fifty peers beat an ordinary one with three hundred and fifty, which is backwards: the second one starts playing and the first one crawls. Trust, resolution and audio still decide between releases of comparable health. Every release now says which band it is in, in plain words, and the one the ranking chose is marked BEST PICK rather than merely being the top line of a list.
